review_evidence: README describes the “Démontrer avec un ordinateur” course and its use of Lean for computer-checked mathematical proofs.

Library/Theory/Division.lean, GCD.lean, InjectiveSurjective.lean, ModEq/*, NumberTheory.lean, Parity*.lean and Prime.lean define and prove reusable arithmetic/number-theory interfaces, including quotient-remainder and Bézout results.

The Math2001 lesson files add checked examples on equalities, inequalities, structured logic, induction, recurrence, and functions; the unit-wide declaration scan found about 138 declarations, so tutorial status is not a lossless exclusion criterion.
summary: Retain demontrer2025: the Lean course repository contains a substantial reusable theory library and many checked mathematical exercises, not merely teaching logistics.
